name: pukial-flutter
description: Pukial Flutter toolkit for Claude Code: the ship-check architecture gate (review -> triage -> fix -> recommend) and the new-app scaffolder for com.pukial Flutter apps. Pairs with the flutter-pukial-starter, which provides the per-repo Makefile, env, and settings the skills rely on. Also carries deckwright: idea -> binding spec -> HTML drafts on a design system -> native editable PPTX or printable HTML deck, with a QA loop.
